attempts.notes: The only published chip-ID teardown in this family is iFixit's Mavic 3 Pro main-board identification, which flags a 'likely Leadcore H6MN' applications processor plus Leadcore E2B/P1 and an HDSC HC32F176 MCU; no Mavic 3 Enterprise-specific chip identification was found. No source names the foundry for that processor, and the one source describing Leadcore calls it a fabless ('foundry-less') designer, so no Tier 2 fabrication entry could be sourced.
